instructions: SML is the Samva template toolchain: @samva/markup, @samva/editor, and @samva/vite, plus examples/email-starter. Follow root AGENTS.md, then the package AGENTS.md for the tree you are in. Build order is markup, then editor, then vite. Prefer logic findings over style.

rules.rule: Build @samva/markup first, then @samva/editor, then @samva/vite. The root build script runs them in that order because the editor imports markup's published entries and the Vite plugin build bundles packages/vite/editor, which imports the editor. Do not reorder that script or make one package compile against another's source.

Packages import each other only through declared dependencies and published exports, never through relative paths or another package's src. packages/markup/tests/authoring-boundary.test.ts enforces this.

examples/email-starter is not a workspace member. It pins the published @samva/markup and @samva/vite releases and installs from its own bun.lock. Do not add it to the root workspaces array or point it at workspace packages. scripts/refresh-starter.ts moves its pins after a release.

Generated files are regenerated, not edited. packages/markup/generated/* comes from bun run --filter @samva/markup codegen:contract, and packages/markup/src/email/tailwind-stylesheets.gen.ts comes from codegen:tailwind. Do not hand-edit the vendored JSON Schema dialect in packages/markup/src/json-schema.

A change customers notice gets a Tegami changeset under .tegami/. A change that makes previously valid templates fail adds an upgrade recipe to the diagnostic code it reports, so hosted and local agents can migrate projects.
Template authors install @samva/markup and @samva/vite, so neither may list Effect in dependencies or peerDependencies. @samva/editor takes Effect, React, and Base UI as peers.

throw, try/catch, built-in Error construction, and hand-rolled object guards are lint errors outside tests and tooling (samva/no-try-catch-or-throw, samva/no-error-constructor, and samva/no-hand-rolled-object-guard in scripts/oxlint-plugin-samva.js). A real boundary takes an inline oxlint-disable naming the rule and the reason.

packages/markup/tests/email-parity.test.ts pins the compiler's published output to golden digests that Samva's hosted runtime also asserts. Change those digests only for an intended output change, and say so in the Tegami changeset.

A template body is read, not run. The compiler produces versioned JSON IR, and rendering is a pure function of that IR and the input. Do not add an execution path, a raw-HTML escape hatch, or a body that computes over its input. New findings go in DIAGNOSTIC_CODES with a fix.

The editor never compiles. The host owns render truth and the editor mounts the render produced from the template IR. Each EditorProvider owns one vanilla zustand store; do not add a module-level store or zustand middleware. Effect Atom owns host application and server state; zustand owns editor-internal state. A visual edit stays inside the static profile: applySourceReplacements runs with a ProfileGuard, and a conditional className is refused rather than overwritten.

Every check, render, and preview is compileTemplate from @samva/markup/compiler followed by renderIr. Do not execute a template module. buildTemplates, renderTemplate, and renderChannel return discriminated results with an ok field and do not throw for a finding about source. Do not commit or hand-edit .samva/; it is generated and gitignored.
